title: Owner decision: keep, move or remove 'Reload models' and the config.json line
goal: The owner decides in plain words what happens to the Edited config.json line and the Reload models button
acceptance: Findings in the record: the button posts /api/models/reload, which makes the brain re-read config.json models and keeps the old settings if the file is invalid; nothing watches the file, so a hand edit applies only by this button, `nerv reload` or a restart; the model picker in settings already writes config and reloads by itself, so it does not need the button

Recommendation: move it into a collapsed Advanced section of the settings panel (hand edits and `ollama pull` are rare, but without it the only way is a CLI command or restart); plain text 'Re-read the model settings from config.json', result shown next to the button
Owner picked move: the decision is written in the record and on the decision page
privacy: Neutral invented data only; no personal data, tokens or private reports in Git.
escalation: A material scope or effort increase goes to the owner

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-26 from the existing code paths read for this plan. Not a measurement. Closed 2026-11-27: the owner answered "ok" in chat at about 00:10 CET to the recommendation, so the choice is: move. No actual: owner time not measured.
